theme_strategy: Dual Theme (Light/Dark toggle) - Emphasizing Apple's 'Liquid Glass' Aesthetic. Deep Navy/Charcoal for Dark, Pristine Frost White for Light.

core_colors.name: Deep Navy
core_colors.usage: Primary background for Dark Mode, authoritative contrast for text in Light Mode.

core_colors.name: Frost White
core_colors.usage: Primary background for Light Mode, pristine and clean.

core_colors.name: College Blue
core_colors.usage: The single premium accent color. Used for CTAs, active states, and progress bars. Creates electric contrast against Navy.

fonts.heading: Outfit
fonts.install_command: Use Google Fonts for Outfit and Manrope in index.html or import in css.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ font-medium tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white

rules: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
Never center-align dense text; use center alignment strictly for hero headers or standalone CTAs.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: The 'Apple Liquid Glass' effect is mandatory for the sticky navbar, floating modals, and dashboard metric cards. Must include backdrop-saturate-150 to make underlying colors pop.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays (opacity 2-3%) on the deep navy backgrounds to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.corners: Rounded-2xl for primary cards, rounded-full for pills and primary buttons.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0055FF] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-[#0044CC] transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,85,255,0.4)] hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.glass: bg-white/10 dark:bg-black/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-full hover:bg-white/20 transition-all duration-300

component_styles.cards: Use liquid_glass_surfaces classes. Do NOT use solid white or solid black for cards over complex backgrounds.
component_styles.inputs: bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0055FF]/50 focus:border-[#0055FF] transition-all outline-none
component_styles.modals: Apply heavy glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-3xl). Include a 1px border. Animate entrance with Framer Motion (scale 0.95 -> 1, opacity 0 -> 1).
component_styles.charts: Use Recharts. Line and Bar charts must use the primary College Blue (#0055FF) with gradient fills under the line (opacity 0.2 to 0). Hide standard grid lines, use only faint horizontal dashed lines for ultra-minimalism.

layouts.general: Mobile-first responsive. Use generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) to create luxurious breathing room.
layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid style. High density for Admin Analytics. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-6.
layouts.forms: Max-width containers (max-w-2xl) centered on screen. Use a progress bar at the top of the card.
layouts.navbar: Sticky at top, z-50. Must use Crystal Glassmorphism. If scrolled, add a subtle border-b.

motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide up (Framer Motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}).
motion.hover_states: Cards lift on hover: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
motion.micro_interactions: Thank-you animations after feedback submission (use a checkmark drawing animation or Confetti). Use skeleton loaders for async data.
motion.forms: Smooth transition between form steps. No abrupt jumps.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast on glass surfaces meets APCA/WCAG standards. Darken text on light glass, lighten text on dark glass.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-btn').

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a refined, premium feel.
media.illustrations: Avoid generic vector art. Use high-quality photography with blue/dark overlays to match the aesthetic.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly required for this portal unless adding a 3D campus model. Stick to Framer Motion for 2D Liquid Glass physics to maintain 60fps performance.

hero_background.description: Dark blue abstract premium background. Perfect for the Landing Page hero section behind a glassmorphic login card.

campus_architecture.description: Premium modern college campus architecture. Great for the 'About' section or Event module placeholder.

students_library.description: Students in a modern university library. Good for the Academic Feedback context.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn UI but heavily customize the styles to match the 'liquid_glass_surfaces' defined above.
Replace generic default fonts with Outfit (Headings) and Manrope (Body).
For the Feedback Forms: Implement a stepped layout with a clean progress bar. Hide native radio buttons and use styled rating stars (1-5).
For the Admin Dashboard: Build a Bento grid layout using Recharts for analytics. Ensure charts are minimalistic (no grid noise).
For the Events Module: Create a clean list/card view with auto-unlock visual cues (e.g., a lock icon that transitions to an 'Open Form' button).
Role-based routing is critical: Implement mock auth that clearly routes to Student, Faculty, or Admin dashboards based on role selection.
NEVER use transparent dropdown menus; they must have a solid or heavily blurred frosted background.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Use Framer Motion extensively.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
